newsitem.title: USA: First American to buy Strategic Mortgage.
newsitem.headline: First American to buy Strategic Mortgage.

text.p: First American Financial Corp on Thursday said it agreed to buy all of the operations of Strategic Mortgage Services Inc and its units except for its flood-zone certification business.
Financial terms were not disclosed in the statement issued by First American.
The acquisition is scheduled to close in early May.
The businesses to be acquired employ 820 people and generated revenues of about $80 million in 1996.
Strategic Mortgage is a leading provider of real estate information services to the U.S. mortgage and title insurance industries.
The acquisition, when completed, will reinforce First American's position as the leading U.S. provider of real estate-related financial and informational services, it said.
